posts.trend: Who is Rakesh Ranjan? Former Zomato CEO appointed Uber India and South Asia chief, to take charge from January 4, 2027
posts.context: Thirty-year-olds rely on the same two apps for late-night dinner and getting home safely, and now the same executive has run both.
posts.angle: Your 11 PM hunger and your 11 PM commute have been consolidated under one management philosophy.

landing_options.line: Ab biryani aur auto dono ek hi aadmi cancel karega.
11 baje ke baad dono mana kar dete hain.
Pehle plate thandi hoti thi. Ab cab.
Dono apps mein ab same surge ka logic chalega.

slides: Zomato ke ex-CEO ab Uber India chalayenge. Same phone, same aadmi.

Mummy ne link bheja: "Beta, inko bolna raat ko surge kam rakhein."
"Mummy, main delivery nahi karwata unse."
"Toh kya hua, pehle khaana laate the, ab ghar chhodenge."
Ab biryani aur auto dono ek hi aadmi cancel karega.
posts.caption: Whose mother thinks knowing the CEO's name gets you zero surge pricing

tweet.setup: The former boss of my food delivery app is now going to run my cab app.
tweet.punch: Now one man controls whether I reach home or eat dinner at midnight.

messages.text: Beta yeh news dekhi? Khaana wali company ka boss ab taxi wali mein gaya hai
Acha hai na, ab tumhe raat ko cab sasti milegi
Mummy unko nahi pata main kaun hoon
Phir bhi complaint daal dena ki biryani aur auto dono mehenge hain

posts.rank_verdict: Slide 2 sets up Mummy complaining about surge pricing, so Slide 3 jumping to cancellations feels slightly disconnected from the middle beat and relies heavily on local news.
